title: Rakshan the Ghost
desc: A former Interpol officer with a troubled past unleashes his skills in an attempt to protect his beloved family from kidnappers, rivals and death.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.

title: Bad Girl
desc: On the cusp of adulthood, Ramya wants to fall in love with the perfect guy. But it's hard because she has to balance what she wants with what society and her parents expect of her.

title: Deva Dassu
desc: Dr Das, a reserved man, finds his routine life upended when Deva, a fugitive gangster on the run from police, seeks refuge in his clinic. Over time, a profound friendship blossoms between them.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kadavul Padaitha Manidargal
desc: The lives of two mortal orphans undergo a series of upheavals thanks to a quarrel between Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Vishnu. It all begins when the two mortals are caught in the drama of a don's life.

title: Penguin
desc: Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

title: Hit (The Second Case)
desc: Krishna Dev, a police inspector, is handed over the case of a gruesome murder. While he attempts to solve the crime, his partner's life is also threatened.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men dream of controlling their wives after marriage, but their chauvinistic mindset backfires, leading to a series of hilarious and troublesome situations.

title: Lucifer
desc: The demise of the leader of a political party leads to a massive power struggle. Amidst the chaos, a mystical man named Stephen comes in to ascend the throne.

title: Veera Simha Reddy
desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.

title: Shivan
desc: A man and a woman are in love with each other but on the day of their wedding, he ends up killing her. Soon, in prison, he realises the conspiracy behind the crime and plans to solve the mystery.
